moral_rights: Moral rights recognized: attribution and objection to distortion (sec. 193)
orphan_works: No orphan-works exception; owners may optionally designate a society to enforce their rights (sec. 183)
digital_protection: Anti-circumvention & rights-management information rules added by RA 10372 (2013)
fair_use_exceptions: Fair use for criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching, scholarship and research (sec. 185); limitations in sec. 184
registration_required: No (protected from creation, sec. 172.1; deposit with National Library and Supreme Court Library, sec. 191)
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL) - Bureau of Copyright and Related Rights
